meta.name: pdf-editor-compdf
meta.description: PDF Editor edits and organizes PDF pages with merge, insert, reorder, exchange, and crop operations, built on ComPDF page management capabilities for fast PDF cleanup and document restructuring. It is a strong fit for requests such as “edit pdf,” “organize pdf pages,” “merge pdf,” “insert pages,” “reorder pdf pages,” “crop pdf pages,” and “rearrange pdf.” Example queries include “Merge these three PDFs into one file,” “Insert this appendix after page 8,” and “Reorder the pages and crop the white margins.”
